meta.name: THI Observed Ratings
meta.sample: completed FBS-vs-FBS scrimmage plays with garbage time excluded

methodology.description: Current-season performance adjusted iteratively for opponents faced and regressed toward the FBS average according to sample size.
methodology.offense_rating: Scoring-scale index: national FBS points per game plus opponent-adjusted offensive EPA deviation times national average plays. Descriptive, not a game score forecast.
methodology.defense_rating: Scoring-scale index: national FBS points per game plus opponent-adjusted defensive EPA allowed deviation times national average plays; lower is better.
methodology.pace_rating: Unadjusted scrimmage plays per game indexed to the FBS average of 1.00; affected by opponent tempo and game script.
methodology.opponent_adjustment: Iterative adjustment from each FBS opponent's season-wide efficiency; one opponent contributes once per game. Aggregate approximation, not a play-level opponent model.
methodology.provisional_policy: One qualifying FBS game: show values separately without ranks or percentiles.
